Hong Kong's First Post-Colonial Leader Tung Chee-hwa Dies at 89

Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first leader after the 1997 handover from British to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89. A former shipping tycoon, he was selected by Beijing to govern the former British colony. His tenure, which concluded when he stepped down in 2005, was marked by crises and protests.
